source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: يوم الجمعة، رحنا نزور جدتي بالضيعة.
sentences.en: On Friday, we went to visit my grandmother in the village.

sentences.ar: الطريق عالضيعة كان طويل وفيه جبال.
sentences.en: The road to the village was long and had mountains.

sentences.ar: لما وصلنا، جدتي كانت مستنيتنا عالباب.
sentences.en: When we arrived, my grandmother was waiting for us at the door.

sentences.ar: عزمتنا على غدا كبير طبخته من الصبح.
sentences.en: She invited us to a big lunch she had cooked since morning.
We ate maqluba and salad and drank ayran.

sentences.ar: بعد الغدا، قعدنا بالحديقة نشرب شاي.
sentences.en: After lunch, we sat in the garden drinking tea.
My grandmother told us about the old days.
The kids played with the cats in the yard.

sentences.ar: قبل ما نرجع، عبتلنا جدتي أكل نوخذه.
sentences.en: Before we left, my grandmother packed us food to take.
We went home with our hearts full of love.
